items.title: Anthropic、OpenAI高層籲放緩AI開發 AI概念股跳水、網絡安全股大爆發
items.title_en: Anthropic and OpenAI Executives Call for Slowing AI Development; AI Stocks Plunge While Cybersecurity Shares Surge
paras: 人工智能(AI)熱潮相關股票周一遭遇大幅拋售，市場擔心AI模型開發速度放緩將拖累龐大的AI基礎設施投資及企業獲利前景；與此同時，網絡安全類股則逆勢大漲，投資人押注AI能力快速提升反而將帶來更龐大的資安防護需求。
市場拋售與Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei周末呼籲AI模型開發商放慢開發速度有關。此前，Anthropic研究人員對AI快速發展可能帶來的風險發出警告，引發社群及市場高度關注。OpenAI執行長Sam Altman及SpaceX執行長Elon Musk也相繼表示支持放慢AI發展速度。
Melius Research分析師Ben Reitzes表示，這些AI業者或許非常擅長開發模型，但並不擅長談論股票市場，他們的言論「正在讓市場陷入恐慌」。
投資人擔心，如果AI模型開發速度放緩，企業對晶片、伺服器及數據中心的投資可能同步降溫，進而打擊過去幾年因AI基礎設施支出激增而大幅上漲的科技股。
晶片及伺服器供應商因此遭遇沉重賣壓。美光(MU-US)、英特爾(INTC-US)、Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)及應用材料(AMAT-US)股價均下跌超過4%，輝達(NVDA-US)也下跌約3%。韓國記憶體大廠SK海力士在美國交易時段下跌7%。
AI基礎設施相關企業跌幅更加明顯。惠普企業(HPE-US)股價下跌約11%，戴爾科技(DELL-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)分別下跌6%及4%。雲端AI數據中心業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)下跌約7%，Bernstein分析師此前指出，該公司龐大的偏遠地區數據中心布局，使其成為最容易受到AI投資放緩影響的企業之一。
數據中心類股同樣承壓，Equinix(EQIX-US)及Digital Realty Trust(DLR-US)下跌超過3%；液冷設備供應商Vertiv(VRT-US)則下跌約8%。這反映市場開始重新評估AI數據中心擴張速度、資本支出規模以及相關設備需求。
然而，AI發展放緩的消息卻對網絡安全企業產生完全相反的效果。由於AI系統能力快速提升，企業及政府機構面臨由AI驅動的網絡攻擊風險增加，市場因此認為網絡安全業者可能成為AI時代的重要受益者。
Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)及CrowdStrike(CRWD-US)兩大網絡安全龍頭股價均大漲超過13%。Okta(OKTA-US)、Zscaler(ZS-US)、Qualys(QLYS-US)、SentinelOne(S-US)及Netskope也錄得雙位數升幅。
網絡安全產業今年夏季以來已受到市場高度關注。OpenAI披露其AI代理曾協助策劃針對Hugging Face的攻擊後，外界對AI代理可能被濫用，以及AI系統自主執行任務時出現偏離原始意圖的風險更加警惕。
CrowdStrike與Palo Alto Networks同時深度參與AI模型開發，曾參與OpenAI及Anthropic尚未公開模型的早期測試。這讓兩家公司同時站在AI開發及AI安全防護兩個領域。
SentinelOne執行長Tomer Weingarten表示，網絡安全企業處於特殊位置，可以建立用於監控AI代理行為的防護技術。他指出，目前要辨識AI何時偏離原始意圖，最有效的方法仍是對所有電腦系統進行深入且完整的監控。
AI發展放緩的市場敘事也讓部分此前受到重創的軟件股獲得喘息機會。Salesforce(CRM-US)、Adobe(ADBE-US)及ServiceNow(NOW-US)股價均逆勢上漲，顯示投資人認為AI資本支出降溫可能降低市場對傳統軟件企業遭到AI顛覆的部分疑慮。
這場市場震盪的背後，是華爾街近期對AI風險的激烈討論。Anthropic研究人員Jacob Coxon此前表示，他因擔心Anthropic及OpenAI「拿人類生命下注」而辭職。Anthropic安全研究員Evan Hubinger則表示，他認為未來10年AI「殺死所有人類」的機率超過10%。
相關言論在社交媒體引發巨大反響，並促使AI產業領袖公開回應。Amodei周六發表文章，主張「我們必須放慢提升AI模型能力的速度」，但同時強調並非要求停止AI發展。
Altman周一也在社交平台X發文表示，「控制節奏」並不代表「停止」。他指出，AI進步一直非常迅速，未來仍將持續，但發展速度應低於原本可能達到的速度，因為安全評估及監控等干預措施本身具有成本。
對金融市場而言，AI發展速度之所以受到如此高度關注，與AI基礎設施龐大的資本支出有直接關係。市場預期全球每年投入AI基礎設施的資金將超過1兆美元，任何可能拖慢這項投資的因素，都可能對美股盈利及企業利潤率產生廣泛影響。
One Point BFG Wealth Partners首席投資官Peter Boockvar表示，美國經濟、美國股市以及美國企業盈利和利潤率的發展軌跡，都已高度押注這波AI資本支出，因此任何對AI投資產生負面影響的因素，都足以解釋近期市場拋售。
不過，部分分析師認為，AI開發速度即使放緩，也不代表AI需求將同步消失。Quilter Cheviot全球科技研究主管Ben Barringer表示，AI發展速度即使有所下降，技術變革的速度仍將非常快。
Barringer指出，即使AI模型訓練及產品推出速度放緩，推理(inference)仍是整個產業供應短缺的環節。推理是指AI模型實際執行任務的過程，與訓練模型時利用大量數據改善底層模型有所不同。
他認為，目前AI推理需求仍遠遠超過供應，因此即使AI發展速度稍微放慢，相關企業營收未必會受到明顯影響。
這也意味著，周一的市場波動更可能反映投資人重新評估AI資本支出的速度及估值，而非AI需求突然消失。短期而言，晶片、伺服器及數據中心企業可能繼續受到AI投資放緩預期壓力，但如果推理需求持續超過供應，AI產業的實際營收增長仍可能保持韌性。
相較之下，網絡安全企業則可能從AI能力快速提升所帶來的新風險中受益。隨著AI代理、自動化工具及模型能力持續發展，企業需要投入更多資源監控AI行為、防止模型遭到濫用及抵禦由AI驅動的攻擊，資安支出可能因此成為AI產業發展中的另一條成長主線。
paras_en: AI‑related stocks faced heavy selling on Monday as the market worries that a slowdown in AI model development could drag down massive AI infrastructure investments and corporate profit outlooks; at the same time, cybersecurity stocks rallied sharply as investors bet that faster AI capabilities will create greater security‑spending demand.

The sell‑off is linked to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s weekend plea for AI model developers to slow their pace. Earlier, Anthropic researchers had warned about risks from rapid AI progress, drawing intense community and market attention. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk also voiced support for a slower AI development pace.
Melius Research analyst Ben Reitzes said these AI firms may be excellent at building models but are not good at discussing the stock market, and their comments are "driving the market into panic."

Investors fear that if AI model development slows, corporate spending on chips, servers and data centers could cool off as well, hurting tech stocks that have surged in recent years on a boom in AI infrastructure spending.

Chip and server makers felt the pressure. Micron (MU‑US), Intel (INTC‑US), Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) and Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) all fell more than 4%, while Nvidia (NVDA‑US) slipped about 3%. South Korean memory giant SK Hynix dropped 7% during U.S. trading hours.

AI‑infrastructure companies fell even more. Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) slid about 11%, Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) fell 6% and 4% respectively. Cloud AI data‑center operator CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) dropped roughly 7%; Bernstein analysts had previously noted that the company’s large footprint of remote data centers makes it especially vulnerable to a slowdown in AI investment.

Data‑center stocks also felt the strain, with Equinix (EQIX‑US) and Digital Realty Trust (DLR‑US) each down over 3%, and liquid‑cooling equipment supplier Vertiv (VRT‑US) falling about 8%. This reflects a market reassessment of AI data‑center expansion speed, cap‑ex scale and related equipment demand.

However, news of a slower AI rollout had the opposite effect on cybersecurity firms. As AI system capabilities rise quickly, enterprises and governments face heightened risk of AI‑driven cyber attacks, leading the market to view cybersecurity providers as key beneficiaries in the AI era.

Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) and CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US), the two leading cybersecurity stocks, both surged more than 13%. Okta (OKTA‑US), Zscaler (ZS‑US), Qualys (QLYS‑US), SentinelOne (S‑US) and Netskope also posted double‑digit gains.

The cybersecurity sector has been under intense market focus since this summer. After OpenAI disclosed that its AI agent helped plan an attack on Hugging Face, concerns grew about the misuse of AI agents and the risk that autonomous AI systems might deviate from their original intent.

Both CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks are deeply involved in AI model development and participated in early testing of unreleased models from OpenAI and Anthropic, placing them at the intersection of AI creation and AI security.

SentinelOne CEO Tomer Weingarten said cybersecurity firms are uniquely positioned to build protective technologies that monitor AI agent behavior. He noted that the most effective way today to detect when AI deviates from its intended purpose is comprehensive, deep monitoring of all computer systems.

The slower‑AI narrative also gave some heavily hit software stocks a breather. Salesforce (CRM‑US), Adobe (ADBE‑US) and ServiceNow (NOW‑US) all rose against the trend, suggesting investors think a cooling of AI cap‑ex may ease worries that traditional software firms will be displaced by AI.

Behind this market turbulence is Wall Street’s recent heated debate over AI risk. Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon previously resigned because he feared Anthropic and OpenAI were "betting human lives," while Anthropic safety researcher Evan Hubinger said he believes the probability that AI will "kill all humans" within the next decade exceeds 10%.

The remarks sparked huge reactions on social media and prompted AI industry leaders to respond publicly. Amodei posted an article on Saturday arguing, "We must slow the pace of improving AI model capabilities," while emphasizing he is not calling for a halt to AI development.

Altman also tweeted on Monday that "controlling the pace" does not mean "stopping". He noted AI progress has been extremely rapid and will continue, but the speed should be lower than the maximum possible because safety assessments and monitoring add cost.

For financial markets, the intense focus on AI development speed is directly tied to the massive cap‑ex required for AI infrastructure. The market expects global AI infrastructure spending to exceed $1 trillion annually, and any factor that could slow that investment could broadly affect U.S. earnings and corporate profit margins.

Peter Boockvar, CIO of One Point BFG Wealth Partners, said the trajectory of the U.S. economy, stock market and corporate profitability is heavily predicated on this wave of AI cap‑ex, so any negative impact on AI investment can explain the recent sell‑off.

Nevertheless, some analysts argue that even if AI development slows, demand for AI will not disappear. Ben Barringer, head of global technology research at Quilter Cheviot, said that while the pace of AI progress may dip, the speed of technological change will remain very fast.

Barringer noted that even if model training and product launches slow, inference remains the bottleneck in the industry’s supply chain. Inference is the phase where AI models actually perform tasks, distinct from training that uses massive data to improve the underlying model.
He believes current AI inference demand far outstrips supply, so a modest slowdown in AI development may not noticeably affect revenue for related companies.

Thus, Monday’s market swing likely reflects investors reassessing the speed and valuation of AI cap‑ex rather than a sudden disappearance of AI demand. In the short term, chip, server and data‑center firms may stay under pressure from expectations of slower AI investment, but if inference demand stays above supply, AI industry revenue growth could remain resilient.

By contrast, cybersecurity firms stand to benefit from new risks created by rapidly advancing AI capabilities. As AI agents, automation tools and model abilities evolve, enterprises will need to spend more on monitoring AI behavior, preventing model misuse and defending against AI‑driven attacks, making security spending another growth pillar in the AI ecosystem.

items.title: 川普突襲致電黃仁勳 聯手拆解「AI末日論」
items.title_en: Trump Calls Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to Counter “AI Doomsday” Narrative
paras: 美國總統川普週一 (14 日) 意外致電正在洛杉磯All-In Summit受訪的輝達執行長黃仁勳。黃仁勳當場開啟擴音，讓現場觀眾聽見兩人對話。面對近期升溫的AI安全爭議，兩人均反對AI將接管甚至毀滅人類的「末日論」，但黃仁勳的態度相對審慎，強調業界仍應認真看待吹哨者提出的安全警告。
川普在通話中表示：「機器人不會接管世界，AI也不會掌控全球，整件事就是一場騙局。」
川普認為，美國發展AI仍須保持一定程度的謹慎，但不應因此停止技術進步。黃仁勳則回應，美國能夠在確保安全的同時領導AI發展，並將努力讓每個產業、每家公司、每個州及所有人，都能在這場AI競賽中受益。
川普與黃仁勳隔空反擊AI末日論，正值多名科技業領袖與AI專家基於安全疑慮，呼籲業界放慢先進模型開發之際。
川普週一也在Truth Social發文，稱自己正在揭穿另一場「騙局」，也就是AI將接管、吞噬並摧毀世界的說法。
黃仁勳：美國可以安全領先AI
黃仁勳對AI風險的立場比川普更為審慎。他表示，AI安全至關重要，但美國仍能在確保安全的同時快速推進技術發展。
針對前Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon上週辭職並公開示警，黃仁勳稱讚Coxon有勇氣提出內部疑慮。Coxon曾表示，參與AI開發的人員相信，AI可能在2030年前毀滅全人類。
不過，黃仁勳強調，揭露企業內部已存在的問題，與預測AI未來將毀滅人類是兩件不同的事。他支持吹哨者提出警告，但認為AI將導致人類滅亡的預測缺乏科學依據。
黃仁勳坦言，他並不知道Coxon在Anthropic內部實際看見什麼，但目前尖端AI實驗室正艱難地由研究組織轉型為工程組織。若AI公司認為自身技術已經失控，就應暫停或放慢開發步調。
暗示資安警報可能創造市場需求
黃仁勳過去曾多次反駁AI末日論，認為部分宛如科幻小說的極端情境，可能嚇阻市場投資能讓AI變得更安全的技術。
他也曾暗示，部分圍繞AI的資安警報，可能有助於資安業者創造市場需求。黃仁勳上週在高盛舊金山會議上表示：「有什麼比製造問題更能創造需求？誰不希望市場對自己的產品陷入狂熱，讓顧客在門外大排長龍？」
輝達是先進AI模型所需晶片的主要供應商，AI產業能否持續擴張，與其業務前景高度相關。
Anthropic、OpenAI及xAI領袖呼籲放慢先進AI模型開發後，晶片股和記憶體股週一 (14日) 血染一片，iShares半導體ETF (SOXX-US) 週一重挫5.63%，美光 (MU-US) 摔落5.25%，Marvell (MRVL-US) 下殺7.32%，輝達 (NVDA-US) 下挫3.36%。
AI雲端運算服務商同樣承壓，Nebius (NBIS-US) 下跌5.50%，CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 下挫6.75%。
資金轉向軟體與網路安全族群。Global X 網路安全 ETF (BUG-US)瘋漲10.66%，創掛牌以來最大單日漲幅。
CrowdStrike (CRWD-US) 週一大漲13.85%，Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US) 勁揚13.09%，反映市場預期AI安全疑慮升高，可望帶動企業增加網路安全與監控支出。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump unexpectedly called Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Monday (the 14th) while Huang was being interviewed at the All‑In Summit in Los Angeles. Huang turned on a microphone so the audience could hear the conversation. Both men rejected the “doomsday” view that AI will take over or destroy humanity, though Huang was more cautious, stressing that the industry must still take whistle‑blower safety warnings seriously.
Trump said during the call, “Robots won’t take over the world, AI won’t control the globe – the whole thing is a scam.”

Trump believes the United States should remain prudent in developing AI but should not halt technological progress because of it. Huang replied that the U.S. can lead AI development while ensuring safety, and will work to let every industry, every company, every state and every person benefit from the AI race.
Trump and Huang’s joint rebuttal of the AI doomsday narrative comes as several tech leaders and AI experts, citing safety concerns, are urging the industry to slow down advanced model development.
On Monday Trump also posted on Truth Social, claiming he was exposing another “scam” – the notion that AI will take over, devour and destroy the world.
Huang: The U.S. Can Lead AI Safely
Huang’s stance on AI risk is more measured than Trump’s. He said AI safety is critical, but the United States can still push rapid technological advancement while safeguarding security.

Regarding former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon’s resignation last week and public warning, Huang praised Coxon’s courage in raising internal concerns. Coxon had warned that people working on AI believe it could wipe out humanity before 2030.

However, Huang emphasized that exposing internal corporate issues is different from predicting AI will annihilate humanity. He supports whistle‑blowers’ alerts but says forecasts of AI‑driven human extinction lack scientific basis.

Huang admitted he does not know exactly what Coxon saw inside Anthropic, but noted that cutting‑edge AI labs are struggling to transition from research groups to engineering organizations. If an AI firm feels its technology is out of control, it should pause or slow development.
Hinting that cybersecurity alerts could generate market demand
Huang has repeatedly pushed back against AI doomsday scenarios, calling some extreme, sci‑fi‑like visions a deterrent that could scare investors away from funding safety‑enhancing technologies.

He also hinted that some AI‑related cybersecurity alerts might actually create demand for security vendors. At a Goldman Sachs event in San Francisco last week, Huang said, “What creates demand more than making problems? Who doesn’t want the market to go crazy for their product, with customers lining up around the block?”
Nvidia is a major supplier of chips needed for advanced AI models, and the AI industry’s growth prospects are closely tied to its business outlook.

After Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI leaders called for slowing advanced AI model development, chip and memory stocks slumped on Monday (the 14th): the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) fell 5.63%, Micron (MU‑US) dropped 5.25%, Marvell (MRVL‑US) plunged 7.32%, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) slid 3.36%.
AI cloud service providers also felt the pressure, with Nebius (NBIS‑US) down 5.50% and CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) down 6.75%.
Funds shifted toward software and cybersecurity groups. The Global X Cybersecurity ETF (BUG‑US) surged 10.66%, its biggest single‑day gain since listing.

CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US) jumped 13.85% on Monday and Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) rose 13.09%, reflecting market expectations that heightened AI safety concerns will spur companies to increase spending on cybersecurity and monitoring.

items.title: 美銀示警秋季停滯性通膨！柴油、30年期美債殖利率與AI生產力成「三重」壓力
paras: 美國銀行首席投資策略師Michael Hartnett警告，市場正面臨柴油價格飆升、長天期美債殖利率走高，以及AI投資熱潮背後生產力疑慮等三重壓力，可能共同推升今年秋季的停滯性通貨膨脹風險。
Hartnett在最新一期《Flow Show》報告中指出，創紀錄的柴油價格、30年期美債殖利率升至2007年以來高點，加上AI熱潮掩蓋下的生產力問題，正逐漸形成不利於市場的宏觀環境。
他將安碩運輸平均ETF(IYT-US) 視為目前最重要的觀察指標之一。安碩運輸平均ETF目前正測試200日均線約80點的支撐，一旦有效跌破，可能代表夏季「最佳時機已過」的宏觀去風險化，進一步演變成秋季停滯性通貨膨脹事件。
Hartnett並警告：「平靜的市場加上強硬的政策，是波動性的溫床」，並認為現在仍不算太晚，投資人可以開始對AI泡沫相關股指進行避險。
與此同時，資金流向也顯示市場情緒正在出現變化。過去3週，美股平均每週淨流入僅約70億美元，遠低於7月高峰時的520億美元；美國股票更出現2026年1月以來最大的3週淨流出，規模達142億美元。

柴油價格成實體經濟關鍵壓力

雖然原油價格重新站上每桶100美元受到市場高度關注，但Hartnett認為，真正值得警惕的是柴油市場。
他指出，柴油是「實體經濟的壓力核心」，航運、卡車運輸、農業、營建及採礦等產業都高度依賴柴油，因此柴油成本大幅上升，對整體工業經濟的影響不容忽視。
目前柴油裂解價差已升至每桶102美元，創下歷史新高；柴油零售價格也攀升至每加侖6美元，同樣刷新歷史紀錄。
相較之下，原油價格仍低於烏克蘭危機期間的高點。Hartnett認為，原油與柴油市場之間的明顯背離，反映煉油端正承受異常壓力。
在他設定的市場觀察框架中，安碩運輸平均ETF若跌破200日均線80點支撐，將是秋季停滯性通貨膨脹情境進一步獲得確認的重要訊號。

30年期美債殖利率飆高 債券避險效果減弱

另一項市場壓力來自債市。30年期美債殖利率已升至2007年6月以來最高水準，但市場目前仍未出現明顯恐慌。
Hartnett援引歷史經驗指出，市場往往會測試政策制定者的決心。例如2026年7月31日美日聯合干預後，日元一度測試160關卡，之後才回落至154以下；2012年宣布QE3後隔日，30年期美債殖利率單日跳升16個基點；2020年QE4推出後數日內，30年期美債殖利率更大幅上升51個基點。
Hartnett表示，目前「殖利率見頂」交易正在發揮作用，SPDR S&P 生物科技股 ETF(XBI-US) 、SPDR S&P 區域銀行 ETF(KRE-US) 、不動產投資信託（REITs）及小型股等長天期資產已提前出現反彈，但相關走勢並未獲得資金流入同步支持。
在2000年至2019年的「長期停滯」時代，股票與債券呈負相關，當時即使債券殖利率僅有2%至3%，也能提供額外的配置價值。
然而，目前股票與債券報酬率重新呈現正相關，投資人可能需要更高殖利率才會大舉轉向債券，代表債券原本具備的分散風險效果正在快速減弱。

AI投資逾1.5兆美元 生產力卻令人擔憂

除了能源與債市，Hartnett也對AI熱潮提出更直接的質疑。
他指出，過去3年AI相關投資累計已超過1.5兆美元，但從整體經濟來看，生產力改善的證據仍然不足；全要素生產率（TFP）目前甚至跌破長期趨勢線，而該指標過去50年來與消費者信心高度相關。
AI投資熱潮也反映在股市估值上。Hartnett指出，標普500指數的自由現金流殖利率已降至歷史低檔。
數據顯示，高自由現金流股票組合VFLO今年以來上漲37%，優於大盤；在2022年這個典型的停滯性通貨膨脹年份，VFLO仍上漲9%，同期標普500 ETF（SPY）則下跌18%。
Hartnett對此表示：「有時候，主街知道華爾街不知道的事情。」

全球資金轉向債券與加密貨幣

最新一週全球資金流向顯示，債券吸引175億美元資金，現金流入129億美元，股票流入98億美元，加密貨幣流入13億美元，黃金則流入6億美元。
其中，全球債券已連續4週錄得資金淨流入，平均每週規模約180億美元；投資級債券則連續第23週出現資金淨流入，單週達50億美元。
其他市場方面，中國股票時隔6週首度出現資金淨流入，規模11億美元；材料類股連續第10週獲得資金流入，金額達19億美元；加密貨幣近6週累計淨流入68億美元，資金動能仍然強勁。
Hartnett的專有賣出指標本週由9.6降至9.5，主要受到股票資金流入放緩，以及醫療保健類股出現資金外流影響。
值得注意的是，自5月2日該指標發出賣出訊號以來，標普500指數累計仍上漲1.0%，全球MSCI ACWI指數也上漲1.5%，市場至今尚未出現明顯修正。
Hartnett認為，市場迄今維持相對平靜，反而可能代表後續風險釋放的壓力正在累積。

items.title: 蘋果Siri迎來AI大改版 iOS 27正式上線
items.title_en: Apple's Siri Gets Major AI Overhaul as iOS 27 Launches
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週一 (14 日) 正式推出iOS 27，最大亮點是全面改版的Siri AI。新版Siri可搜尋裝置內的電子郵件、訊息及行事曆等個人資料，進行多輪對話並跨App完成任務，成為蘋果追趕OpenAI、Anthropic及Google等AI業者的重要一步。
不過，Siri AI目前仍處於測試階段，用戶須在設定中主動開啟，部分用戶可能還要登記候補名單才能取得使用權限。蘋果也表示，使用雲端伺服器的部分Siri AI及Apple Intelligence功能將設有每日使用上限，未來可付費提高額度。
主打「真正個人化」 Siri可跨App搜尋資料
蘋果執行長特納斯 (John Ternus) 上週在iPhone發表會上表示，這是「真正屬於個人的個人智慧」，並強調iPhone位於蘋果智慧功能與服務生態系統的核心。
新版Siri運用大型語言模型搜尋用戶儲存在裝置內的個人資料，包括簡訊、電子郵件及行事曆。用戶可要求Siri從過往訊息中找出地址、食譜或操作說明，也能搜尋網路並回答一般問題。
Siri現在也能維持較長時間的對話，並串連蘋果及第三方App內的資訊。例如，從舊郵件中找出飯店訂房確認、搜尋朋友先前傳送的食譜，或拍下咖啡廳Wi-Fi密碼後，直接將密碼輸入裝置。
蘋果同步推出獨立的Siri AI應用程式，可保存過往查詢及對話紀錄，讓用戶在其他蘋果裝置上接續使用。相較舊版Siri，用戶也能針對先前的回答繼續追問，使用體驗更接近對話式AI助理。
複雜問題交由雲端處理 部分功能未來收費
與OpenAI、Anthropic及Google開發的前沿大型AI模型相比，蘋果主要使用規模較小的自研模型，許多功能可以直接在iPhone和Mac的晶片上運行。
若遇到較複雜的Siri AI查詢，蘋果則會透過「私密雲端運算」處理。這套系統採用Google Cloud基礎設施，並使用輝達 (NVDA-US) 及英特爾 (INTC-US) 晶片；蘋果也運用Google的Gemini協助建立自家模型。
蘋果表示，部分需要雲端運算的Siri AI和Apple Intelligence功能將受到每日使用額度限制，未來將提供付費擴充方案。實際限制可能依功能種類、要求的複雜程度、系統需求及相關政策而異。
能模仿用戶口吻寫信 AI修圖功能同步登場
新版Siri AI也進一步進入Mail與Messages等應用程式，可協助撰寫或修改文字。
蘋果表示，系統能依據用戶與特定對象平常的溝通方式，模仿其慣用語氣及標點符號，並能在輸入過程中提供建議及自動校對，部分第三方App也支援相關功能。
照片App則加入多項AI編輯工具。
「空間重新構圖」可在拍照後調整影像視角，「延伸」功能能以AI擴充照片邊緣，升級版「清除」工具則可移除或重新處理模糊的畫面元素。
捷徑功能也降低使用門檻。用戶只要以自然語言描述需求，系統便能自動建立跨App工作流程。例如，要求手機在離開公司時，自動傳送訊息並附上預計抵達時間。
iPhone 11以上可更新 AI功能另有硬體門檻
iOS 27支援iPhone 11及後續機型，但較進階的Apple Intelligence功能需要iPhone 15 Pro或更新機型。蘋果同日也推出iPadOS 27、macOS 27、watchOS 27及visionOS 27。
語言方面，Siri AI初期支援英文，法文、日文、韓文、葡萄牙文及西班牙文預計於下個月加入。受監管因素影響，新功能初期不會在歐盟及中國市場推出。
除AI功能外，iOS 27也新增更細緻的家長控制選項，包括限制兒童使用內建App、要求家長批准瀏覽新網站，以及依遊戲、娛樂和社群媒體等類別設定使用時間。
蘋果也允許用戶調整Liquid Glass介面的透明程度，範圍從高度透明到完整著色。效能方面，蘋果宣稱App啟動速度最快可提升30%，照片圖庫載入速度最快提升70%，AirDrop傳輸速度最多提高80%，Wi-Fi與行動網路之間的切換也將更加順暢。
蘋果早在今年6月公布新版Siri AI。該公司原先於2024年宣布推出AI版Siri，但相關功能去年遭到延後。隨著iPhone 18系列本週正式上市，iOS 27將成為檢驗蘋果能否憑藉個人化AI體驗追上競爭對手的關鍵測試。
蘋果週一 (14日) 逆勢收紅 0.24% 至每股 333.08 美元，今年迄今漲幅達22.90%。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) on Monday the 14th officially rolled out iOS 27, with the biggest highlight being a completely revamped Siri AI. The new Siri can search personal data such as emails, messages and calendars stored on the device, conduct multi‑turn conversations and complete tasks across apps, marking a key step for Apple to catch up with AI players like OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.

However, Siri AI is still in a testing phase; users must manually enable it in Settings, and some may need to join a waitlist to gain access. Apple also said that cloud‑based portions of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence will have daily usage caps, with paid options to raise the limits in the future.
Promoted as "truly personalized," Siri can search data across apps

Apple’s senior vice president John Ternus said last week at the iPhone event that this is "truly personal intelligence" and emphasized that the iPhone sits at the core of Apple’s intelligent features and services ecosystem.

The new Siri leverages large language models to search personal data stored on the device, including texts, emails and calendars. Users can ask Siri to pull out an address, a recipe or instructions from past messages, as well as browse the web and answer general questions.

Siri can now maintain longer conversations and stitch together information from Apple and third‑party apps. For example, it can locate a hotel reservation confirmation in old emails, find a recipe a friend previously sent, or after photographing a café’s Wi‑Fi password, automatically enter it into the device.

Apple is also releasing a standalone Siri AI app that saves past queries and conversation history, allowing users to continue the interaction on other Apple devices. Compared with the old Siri, users can follow up on previous answers, making the experience closer to a conversational AI assistant.
Complex queries are handled in the cloud; some features will be paid
Compared with cutting‑edge large AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, Apple mainly uses smaller in‑house models, many of which can run directly on iPhone and Mac chips.

When a Siri AI query is too complex, Apple routes it through "private cloud computing" using Google Cloud infrastructure and NVIDIA (NVDA-US) and Intel (INTC-US) chips; Apple also leverages Google’s Gemini to help build its own models.

Apple says that cloud‑based Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features will be subject to daily usage limits, with paid expansion options to come. The actual limits may vary by feature type, query complexity, system demand and related policies.
Can mimic a user’s tone in emails; AI photo‑editing tools debut
The new Siri AI also reaches deeper into Mail and Messages, helping draft or edit text.

Apple says the system can emulate a user’s usual tone and punctuation when communicating with specific contacts, offering suggestions and auto‑proofreading during typing, and some third‑party apps also support the feature.
The Photos app adds several AI editing tools.

"Spatial re‑framing" lets users adjust the perspective of a shot after it’s taken, the "Extend" feature uses AI to expand photo edges, and an upgraded "Erase" tool can remove or retouch blurry elements.

The Shortcuts feature is also made easier to use. Users can describe a need in natural language and the system will automatically create a cross‑app workflow, such as sending a message with an estimated arrival time when leaving the office.
iPhone 11 and newer can update; AI features have additional hardware requirements

iOS 27 supports iPhone 11 and later, but the more advanced Apple Intelligence features require an iPhone 15 Pro or newer. Apple also unveiled iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27 and visionOS 27 on the same day.

Initially Siri AI will support English; French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish are expected next month. Due to regulatory considerations, the new features will not launch initially in the EU or China markets.

Beyond AI, iOS 27 adds finer‑grained parental controls, including restricting children’s use of built‑in apps, requiring parental approval for new website visits, and setting usage limits by categories such as games, entertainment and social media.

Apple also lets users adjust the transparency of the Liquid Glass interface, ranging from highly transparent to fully opaque. Performance claims include up to a 30% faster app launch, up to 70% quicker photo library loading, up to an 80% boost in AirDrop transfer speeds, and smoother switching between Wi‑Fi and cellular networks.

Apple first announced the new Siri AI in June this year. The company originally said an AI‑powered Siri would arrive in 2024, but the features were delayed last year. With the iPhone 18 series launching this week, iOS 27 will be a key test of whether Apple can catch up to rivals through a personalized AI experience.
Apple’s stock rose 0.24% on Monday the 14th to $333.08 per share, up 22.90% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 戰爭、百元油價、美債狂飆三大逆風都扛住 基金經理：新興市場可承受Fed升息風險
items.title_en: War, $100 Oil, and Soaring US Treasuries: Fund Managers Say Emerging Markets Can Weather Fed Rate Hikes
paras: 儘管今年以來全球面臨戰爭、國際油價突破每桶1百美元及美債殖利率攀升等逆風，新興市場資產仍展現韌性，投資人普遍認為漲勢有望延續。
近期油價再度跳漲，加上美國最新通膨數據強於預期，強化市場對聯準會(Fed)本周可能升息的預期，新興市場資產短線承壓。
不過，多位基金經理人仍抱持信心，主要因為新興市場政策可信度已明顯改善，企業獲利維持強勁，更重要的是美元大幅反彈的風險有限。歷史經驗顯示，美元走強向來是新興市場的主要壓力來源。
MFS Investment Management高級董事總經理 Benoit Anne說，「我沒看到新興市場亮起任何警報」，並強調Fed升息前景「對新興市場而言並不是什麼大事」，與以往升息週期不同，市場對美國政策可信度的擔憂正壓制美元走勢，「這會減輕新興市場可能受到的衝擊」。
目前，Anne看好南非、哥倫比亞與匈牙利等國的本幣債券。
整體而言，儘管短線波動難免，新興市場基本面與政策環境的改善，使其具備抵禦外部緊縮壓力的條件，資金配置意願未見明顯消退。
市場普遍預期，Fed本週將開啟三年多來的首次升息，但本次利率決議的博弈激烈程度，或許遠超投資人押注所反映的情況。
paras_en: Despite global headwinds this year—including war, oil prices breaking $100 a barrel, and rising US Treasury yields—emerging‑market assets have shown resilience, and investors broadly expect the uptrend to continue.
Oil prices have jumped again, and stronger‑than‑expected US inflation data has heightened expectations that the Fed may raise rates this week, putting short‑term pressure on emerging‑market assets.

Nevertheless, several fund managers remain confident because emerging‑market policy credibility has markedly improved, corporate earnings stay strong, and, crucially, the risk of a sharp dollar rebound is limited. Historically, a stronger dollar has been the main pressure on emerging markets.

MFS Investment Management senior managing director Benoit Anne said, “I don’t see any warning lights for emerging markets,” emphasizing that the prospect of Fed rate hikes “is not a big deal for emerging markets.” Unlike previous tightening cycles, concerns over US policy credibility are now dampening the dollar’s rise, “which will lessen the impact on emerging markets.”
Anne is currently bullish on local‑currency bonds in South Africa, Colombia and Hungary.

Overall, while short‑term volatility is inevitable, the improving fundamentals and policy environment in emerging markets give them the capacity to withstand external tightening pressures, and there is no clear decline in allocation appetite.

The market broadly expects the Fed to deliver its first rate hike in more than three years this week, but the intensity of the rate‑decision battle may be far greater than what investors’ bets suggest.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉油價大漲、Fed升息在即 美元攀高
items.title_en: New York FX: Oil Surge and Imminent Fed Hike Push Dollar Higher
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周一(14日)多上揚，中東衝突刺激油價上漲，促使投資人湧向美元避險，並提高了聯準會(Fed)本周升息的可能性，都助長美元升勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，約報99.41，盤中一度觸及99.735，是9月2日以來最高。
歐元貶至一個月低點1.153美元，英鎊也貶值0.2%至1.3512美元。
油價跳升令投資人感到不安，並推動全球債券殖利率回到多年高點附近。布蘭特原油一度上漲5%至每桶109.8美元，之後漲幅收斂，報每桶105.61美元。
近幾日油價受到多重力量支撐，最主要支撐來自伊朗支持的胡塞組織攻擊全球最大石油出口國沙烏地阿拉伯。沙國先前已關閉一條用於繞過荷姆茲海峽、通往紅海的主要輸油管線，如今紅海也受到胡塞組織威脅。
美伊戰爭的外交斡旋似乎陷入停滯，目前伊朗與其他波斯灣國家的會議遭到延後，加上中東地區船隻遭到攻擊，也進一步加劇市場對石油供應的疑慮。
ING外匯策略師Francesco Pesole說：「波斯灣局勢仍令人擔憂，加上部分與AI相關的消息進一步打壓股市，在這樣的環境下，美元應可持續獲得支撐。」
市場愈來愈確信，Fed將在本周三升息，以因應能源價格跳升。能源價格上漲已推動柴油價格創下歷史新高，也使8月核心通膨升幅高於預期。
芝商所集團(CME Group)的FedWatch工具數據顯示，交易員押注Fed升息的機率約為90%，高於一周前的約60%。
三菱UFJ金融集團(MUFG)資深外匯分析師Lee Hardman說：「本周初美元溫和走強，受到市場對聯準會將開始收緊貨幣政策的預期升溫所提振。」
不過，美元近期走強並非沒有風險。
Scotiabank分析師Shaun Osborne領導的團隊在報告中表示，「如果Fed維持利率不變，將令市場感到意外，並明顯對美元不利。但如果是一次『鴿派升息』，沒有明確承諾將進一步升息，也可能令美元承壓。」
日元走弱　美元重返154日圓上方
日元明顯走弱，近期因市場押注日本銀行(BOJ，央行)升息而出現的強勁漲勢有所收斂。
美元兌日元上揚0.5%至154.355，脫離上周觸及的近七個月低點153下方。
全球升息預期升溫，已推動美國、歐洲及日本債券殖利率升至多年甚至數十年高點。不過，目前對外匯市場的影響相對有限，因各主要市場殖利率大致同步走高。
市場幾乎篤定日銀周五將升息。日元市場情緒也開始轉變，投機客自2月以來首度轉為淨做多日圓。
英國央行(BOE)預期周四將維持利率不變，但交易員如今預期今年稍晚將升息，並在2027年進一步升息。歐洲央行(ECB)上周已升息。

paras_en: The dollar rose against most major currencies on Monday (the 14th), as the Middle East conflict stoked oil prices, prompting investors to flock to the dollar as a safe haven and raising the odds of a Fed rate hike this week, all of which fueled the dollar's advance.
In late New York trading, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.3% to around 99.41, touching 99.735 intraday, the highest since September 2.
The euro fell to a one-month low of $1.153, while the pound also declined 0.2% to $1.3512.

The oil price spike unsettled investors and pushed global bond yields back near multi-year highs. Brent crude at one point surged 5% to $109.80 a barrel before paring gains to close at $105.61 a barrel.

Oil prices have been supported by multiple forces in recent days, the most significant being attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi group on Saudi Arabia, the world's largest oil exporter. Saudi Arabia had previously shut down a major pipeline used to bypass the Strait of Hormuz and reach the Red Sea, and now the Red Sea is also under threat from the Houthis.

Diplomatic mediation in the US-Iran conflict appears to have stalled, with the current meeting between Iran and other Gulf states postponed, and attacks on vessels in the Middle East have further intensified market concerns over oil supply.

ING FX strategist Francesco Pesole said: 'The Gulf situation remains concerning, and some AI-related news has further weighed on equities. In this environment, the dollar should continue to find support.'

The market is growing increasingly confident that the Fed will hike rates this Wednesday in response to the energy price spike. Rising energy prices have already pushed diesel prices to record highs and caused August core inflation to come in above expectations.
Data from CME Group's FedWatch tool shows traders are pricing in roughly a 90% probability of a Fed rate hike, up from about 60% a week earlier.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior FX analyst Lee Hardman said: 'The dollar has firmed modestly early this week, buoyed by rising market expectations that the Fed will begin tightening monetary policy.'
However, the dollar's recent strength is not without risks.

A team led by Scotiabank analyst Shaun Osborne noted in a report: 'If the Fed holds rates steady, it would surprise the market and be clearly negative for the dollar. But a "dovish hike" without a clear commitment to further tightening could also put pressure on the dollar.'
Yen Weakens; Dollar Reclaims 154 Yen
The yen weakened noticeably, with its recent strong rally driven by market bets on a Bank of Japan (BOJ) rate hike showing signs of fading.
The dollar-yen pair rose 0.5% to 154.355, moving away from below 153, a near-seven-month low touched last week.

Heating global rate-hike expectations have pushed US, European, and Japanese bond yields to multi-year or even multi-decade highs. However, the impact on the FX market has been relatively limited so far, as yields across major markets have risen roughly in tandem.
The market is nearly certain the BOJ will hike rates on Friday. Yen market sentiment has also begun to shift, with speculators turning net long the yen for the first time since February.

The Bank of England (BOE) is expected to hold rates steady on Thursday, but traders now anticipate a hike later this year and further tightening in 2027. The European Central Bank (ECB) hiked rates last week.

items.title: 〈台幣〉一度重貶逾1角 觀望超級央行周量縮收31.688元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Plunges Over 0.1 Unit, Market Awaits as Central Bank Caps Weekly Rate at 31.688
paras: 全球超級央行周登場，受熱錢匯出影響，台北股匯今(14)日連袂走弱，新台幣兌美元一度重貶 1.4 角，但在央行調節下，終場貶勢收斂，以 31.688 元作收，貶值 5 分，市場轉趨觀望，台北及元太外匯市場總成交量縮至 22.755 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.65元，盤中一度重貶 1.41 角，最低來到 31.779 元，不過，整體匯市交易偏冷，在央行稍加調節下，匯價又回到 31.6 字頭，終場收在31.688元、貶值5分，為連續 3 個交易日走貶。
觀察主要貨幣表現，根據央行統計，截至下午4點，美元指數上漲0.44%，主要亞幣互有升貶，新加坡幣貶值0.22%，新台幣貶值0.16%，日元貶0.11%，韓元小貶 0.04%，人民幣則逆勢小升 0.03%。
全球市場本周迎來央行超級周，聯準會(Fed)、日本銀行(BOJ)及英國央行(BOE)將接連公布利率決策。其中，美國通膨與就業數據雙雙偏強，使Fed升息1碼(25個基點)機率突破八成；日銀也可能將利率調升至1.25%。
受中東局勢緊張及AI模型巨頭呼籲放緩產業發展影響，日韓股市午盤後跌勢擴大，台股今日開低震盪，盤中一度重挫786點。隨後在金融股強勢護盤，以及聯電、鴻海先後翻紅的支撐下，跌幅顯著收斂，終場加權指數下跌322.33點，收在45,862.52點，成交金額縮減至6,309.17億元，創下4月8日以來單日新低量。外資今天賣超約 370 億元。
paras_en: Global “super‑central‑bank” week kicked off, and hot‑money outflows weighed on Taipei’s stock and currency markets. On the 14th, the New Taiwan dollar briefly fell 1.4 tenths against the US dollar, but central‑bank intervention narrowed the decline, closing at 31.688 NTD per dollar – a 0.05‑unit depreciation. Trading volume in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market shrank to US$2.2755 billion as the market turned cautious.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.65 NTD per dollar and at one point slipped 1.41 tenths, hitting a low of 31.779 NTD. Overall forex activity was muted, and after a modest central‑bank adjustment the rate rebounded to the 31.6 level, ending the session at 31.688 NTD, down 0.05 units – marking three consecutive days of depreciation.

Looking at major currencies, central‑bank data up to 4 p.m. showed the US dollar index up 0.44%. Among Asian currencies, the Singapore dollar fell 0.22%, the New Taiwan dollar slipped 0.16%, the yen dropped 0.11%, the won edged down 0.04%, while the Chinese yuan rose modestly 0.03% against the dollar.

This week is a “super‑central‑bank” week globally, with the Federal Reserve, Bank of Japan and Bank of England set to announce rate decisions. Strong US inflation and employment data have pushed the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike above 80%, and the BOJ may raise its policy rate to 1.25%.

Tensions in the Middle East and calls from AI‑model giants to slow industry development weighed on Japanese and Korean equities, widening their afternoon declines. Taiwan’s market opened lower and swung sharply, at one point dropping 786 points. However, strong buying in financial stocks and rebounds in UMC and Foxconn helped narrow losses, with the weighted index closing down 322.33 points at 45,862.52, turnover falling to NT$630.917 billion – the lowest single‑day volume since April 8. Foreign investors sold about NT$37 billion today.

items.title: 日央行高層警惕「非線性」通膨衝擊 預期本周將再度升息
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Officials Warn of “Non‑Linear” Inflation Shock, Expect Another Rate Hike This Week
paras: 根據周一(14日)公布的會議紀錄顯示，一位日本央行官員指出，受進口成本上升和匯率波動衝擊影響，日本通膨率急劇攀升，這顯示在貨幣政策決策時，必須將此類價格波動因素納入考量。
上述言論出自日本央行5月主辦的貨幣政策會議。日本央行已於6月將政策利率調升至 1% 的31年新高，並預計在本周再度升息，以因應日益嚴峻的通膨壓力。
央行通常透過升息來抑制需求驅動型通膨。然而，新冠疫情、俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭、美國提高關稅以及中東衝突等事件，使得人們的焦點轉向了供給側通膨。
負責貨幣政策企畫的日央行執行董事中村康治(Koji Nakamura)在會議中指出，日本國內物價對外部衝擊出現了「非線性」反應，消費者物價對進口價格與匯率波動呈現劇烈上揚。他強調，雖然傳統做法是無視供給面衝擊，但若外部衝擊頻繁發生，就不應將其視為暫時現象，因為這會持續推升基底通膨與民眾的通膨預期。
此外，中村表示，日本同時面臨勞動力減少帶動工資上漲的「慢速人口結構衝擊」，此為不可忽視的結構性因素。
自2024年結束長達十年的超寬鬆刺激計畫以來，日央行已承諾將持續升息。當前緊繃的就業市場、日元疲軟導致的進口成本增加，以及中東衝突引發的燃料價格上漲，均加劇了通膨超越 2% 目標的風險。央行未來需將數據分析與實地調查相結合，以更精準掌握企業與家庭行為的改變對通膨預期的影響。
paras_en: According to the minutes released on Monday (the 14th), a Bank of Japan official said that rising import costs and exchange‑rate volatility have caused Japan’s inflation rate to surge sharply, indicating that such price‑fluctuation factors must be taken into account when making monetary‑policy decisions.

The remarks were made at the Bank of Japan’s May monetary‑policy meeting. The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1% in June – a 31‑year high – and expects to hike again this week to cope with mounting inflation pressure.

Central banks usually raise rates to curb demand‑driven inflation. However, events such as the COVID‑19 pandemic, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, higher U.S. tariffs and Middle‑East conflicts have shifted attention toward supply‑side inflation.

Koji Nakamura, an executive director in charge of monetary‑policy planning, said in the meeting that domestic prices in Japan are reacting “non‑linearly” to external shocks, with consumer prices spiking sharply as import prices and exchange rates fluctuate. He stressed that while the traditional approach is to ignore supply‑side shocks, frequent external shocks should not be treated as temporary, as they will keep pushing up core inflation and inflation expectations.
Nakamura also noted that Japan is simultaneously facing a “slow‑moving demographic shock” – a shrinking labor force that is driving wage growth – which is a structural factor that cannot be ignored.

Since ending a decade‑long ultra‑easy stimulus program at the end of 2024, the BOJ has pledged to keep raising rates. A tight labour market, a weak yen that raises import costs, and higher fuel prices from Middle‑East conflicts all heighten the risk of inflation exceeding the 2% target. The bank will need to combine data analysis with on‑the‑ground surveys to more accurately gauge how changes in corporate and household behaviour affect inflation expectations.

items.title: 聯準會升息預期升溫推升美元 亞幣普遍走弱、日元維持7個月高位
items.title_en: Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Heat Up, Boosting the Dollar; Asian Currencies Mostly Weaker, Yen Holds Near 7‑Month High
paras: 受市場對美國聯準會本周升息預期大幅上升影響，美元強勢走高，亞洲貨幣周一(14日)普遍對美元走弱。然而，由於市場押注日本銀行(BOJ)將加速緊縮貨幣政策，日元表現相對堅挺，維持在接近7個月的高位附近。
在美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)加速上漲後，根據 CME FedWatch 工具顯示，市場目前預估聯準會在9月16日會議升息的機率已升至 86%。升息預期的劇增帶動美元指數上漲0.2%至99.35附近，結束了連續兩周的微幅下跌。
美債殖利率同步受到支撐，10年期美債殖利率來到約4.97%，而對政策利率極為敏感的2年期美債殖利率則保持在4.6%以上。
本周全球金融市場迎來關鍵的「超級央行周」，聯準會、英國央行與日本央行將接連公布最新利率決策。市場目前已幾乎完全消化日本銀行周五將升息25個基點(0.25%)的預期，加上投資人預計日本海外資產可能回流，帶動日元本月累積上漲約 4%。
目前美元對日元交投於154.03附近，維持在接近上周創下的2月以來最高點152.89附近，投機客自2月以來首次轉為淨多頭。
在其他主要貨幣方面，歐元對美元下跌0.3%至1.1564，英鎊對美元下跌0.2%至1.3501。亞幣與周邊貨幣普遍承壓，美元對澳元上漲0.4%、對韓元上漲0.25%、對新加坡元上漲0.16%，紐元對美元則下跌0.5%。人民幣表現相對平穩，美元對離岸人民幣微升0.01%至6.7080，印度市場則因國定假日休市。
此外，中東地區的新衝突引發供應疑慮，布蘭特原油期貨大漲近3%至每桶107.60美元。油價持續穩居100美元上方，恐使能源通膨居高不下，進一步增添各國央行在制定利率政策時的複雜度與考驗。
paras_en: The dollar surged as market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike this week rose sharply, causing Asian currencies to generally weaken against the dollar on Monday (the 14th). However, because markets are betting that the Bank of Japan will accelerate its monetary tightening, the yen remained relatively firm, staying near a seven‑month high.

After the U.S. August consumer price index (CPI) accelerated, the CME FedWatch tool showed that the market now estimates an 86% probability that the Fed will raise rates at its September 16 meeting. The surge in rate‑hike expectations lifted the dollar index by 0.2% to around 99.35, ending two weeks of modest declines.
U.S. Treasury yields were supported as well, with the 10‑year yield around 4.97% and the policy‑sensitive 2‑year yield staying above 4.6%.

This week marks a pivotal “super central‑bank week” as the Fed, the Bank of England and the Bank of Japan are set to announce their latest rate decisions. The market has almost fully priced in the BOJ’s expected 25‑basis‑point (0.25%) hike on Friday, and investors anticipate possible repatriation of Japanese overseas assets, driving the yen up about 4% cumulatively this month.
The dollar‑yen pair is trading near 154.03, close to the February‑to‑present peak of 152.89 set last week, with speculators turning net long on the yen for the first time since February.

Among other major currencies, the euro fell 0.3% to $1.1564 and the pound slipped 0.2% to $1.3501. Asian and regional currencies were broadly under pressure: the dollar rose 0.4% against the Australian dollar, 0.25% against the Korean won, and 0.16% against the Singapore dollar, while the New Zealand dollar fell 0.5% versus the dollar. The renminbi was relatively stable, with the offshore yuan edging up 0.01% to 6.7080, and Indian markets were closed for a public holiday.

A new conflict in the Middle East sparked supply concerns, sending Brent crude futures up nearly 3% to $107.60 a barrel. Oil prices staying above $100 a barrel could keep energy‑related inflation high, adding further complexity and challenges for central banks as they set interest‑rate policy.

items.title: 金磚峰會與南方六國首度接入CIPS 人民幣國際支付再擴容
items.title_en: BRICS Summit and Six Southern Nations Join CIPS for the First Time, Expanding RMB International Payments
paras: 2026年9月，全球跨境支付體系出現新動態。第十八屆金磚國家峰會於新德里落幕，會議明確提出深化金磚國家（BRICS）跨境支付合作，推動成員國本土支付系統互聯互通並擴大本幣結算規模。同時，在廈門舉行的第二屆 CIPS 跨境銀企合作活動中，盧安達、土耳其、烏茲別克、馬爾地夫、馬來西亞及喬治亞等六國金融機構首次接入人民幣跨境支付系統（CIPS）。
根據活動數據，期間共有 11 家外資銀行簽署成為 CIPS 直接參與者，4 家境外銀行與 14 家境內銀行完成直參上線。
截至目前，CIPS 參與者已覆蓋全球 133 個國家與地區，服務約 192 個國家和地區的 5,300 家法人銀行，近期單日交易額突破 1.22 兆元人民幣。此外，星展銀行（新加坡）作為首家直連的新加坡銀行，試運行以來累計處理 240 億元人民幣支付；渣打香港則完成了 CIPS 與網聯清算系統的對接，整合跨境與零售支付。
中國國家金融與發展實驗室理事楊濤指出，加強支付合作可降低對美元及西方主導之 SWIFT 體系的依賴，強化金融自主性與抗制裁韌性。他分析，最切合實際的路徑是由雙邊合作逐步擴展至多邊機制。
上海金融研究院副院長劉曉春表示，經由美國清算銀行及 CHIPS 系統進行的美元清算，均處於美國監管視角下。他認為，相較於重新建構獨立的訊息傳遞網路，擴建現有的 CIPS 系統更具可行性。此外，劉曉春評估，在當前各國經濟差異下，推動統一的金磚貨幣並不現實。
中金公司首席經濟學家苗延亮指出，數位人民幣（e-CNY）的可程式化特性有利於大額跨境結算。多邊央行數位貨幣平台 mBridge 截至 2025 年底累計交易額已近 5,000 億元人民幣，其中逾 95% 採用數位人民幣
。然而，苗延亮也提醒，跨管轄區的技術標準與合規體系互通性仍是主要挑戰。
楊濤表示，各國金融體系差異、反洗錢與打擊資恐（AML/CFT）規範不同，以及地緣政治因素，均可能放緩合作落地步調。
劉曉春強調，推動支付合作的關鍵在於尊重市場與商業偏好，而非透過行政手段指定特定貨幣或系統，以利促進區域經貿發展。
paras_en: In September 2026, a new development emerged in the global cross‑border payment system. The 18th BRICS summit concluded in New Delhi, explicitly calling for deeper cross‑border payment cooperation among BRICS members, promoting interconnection of domestic payment systems and expanding settlement in local currencies. At the same time, during the second CIPS cross‑border bank‑enterprise cooperation event in Xiamen, financial institutions from six countries—Rwanda, Turkey, Uzbekistan, the Maldives, Malaysia and Georgia—connected to the People’s Republic of China’s cross‑border payment system (CIPS) for the first time.
According to the event data, a total of 11 foreign‑owned banks signed up to become direct participants in CIPS, while 4 overseas banks and 14 domestic banks completed direct‑participation onboarding.

To date, CIPS participants cover 133 countries and regions worldwide, serving about 5,300 corporate banks in roughly 192 countries and regions. Recent single‑day transaction volume has surpassed RMB 1.22 trillion. Moreover, DBS Bank (Singapore), the first Singapore bank with direct connectivity, has processed RMB 240 billion in payments since its trial launch, and Standard Chartered Hong Kong has completed integration of CIPS with the domestic clearing system, linking cross‑border and retail payments.

Yang Tao, director of China’s National Financial and Development Laboratory, noted that strengthening payment cooperation can reduce reliance on the US‑dominated SWIFT system and the dollar, enhancing financial autonomy and resilience against sanctions. He argued that the most practical path is to expand from bilateral cooperation to multilateral mechanisms.

Liu Xiaochun, vice president of the Shanghai Institute of Financial Research, pointed out that dollar clearing through the US clearing bank and the CHIPS system is subject to US regulatory oversight. He believes that expanding the existing CIPS network is more feasible than building an independent messaging network from scratch, and he assesses that, given current economic disparities, a unified BRICS currency is unrealistic.

Miao Yanliang, chief economist at CICC, highlighted that the programmable nature of the digital yuan (e‑CNY) is advantageous for large‑scale cross‑border settlements. The multilateral central‑bank digital currency platform mBridge has accumulated nearly RMB 500 billion in transaction volume by the end of 2025, with over 95% of that volume using digital yuan.
However, Miao also warned that technical standards and regulatory interoperability across jurisdictions remain major challenges.
Yang Tao added that differences in national financial systems, varying AML/CFT regulations, and geopolitical factors could all slow the pace of cooperation implementation.

Liu Xiaochun emphasized that the key to advancing payment cooperation is respecting market and commercial preferences rather than imposing specific currencies or systems through administrative means, thereby fostering regional trade and economic development.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國CPI上漲，推動美元走強
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: US CPI Rise Fuels Strong Dollar

items.title: 車廠兩難！Stellantis執行長：全球車市分化為「美國」與「其他地區」
items.title_en: Car Makers in a Dilemma! Stellantis CEO: Global Auto Market Split into "USA" and "Other Regions"
paras: Stellantis集團執行長Antonio Filosa上週四(10日)在一場分析師會議上指出，當前全球汽車市場已明顯分化為兩部分：美國與世界其他地區。
Stellantis正面臨美歐等地貿易及政策環境日益分化的挑戰，尤其是與中國企業的合作模式差異顯著。
Filosa強調，美國是Stellantis最主要的利潤來源，但當地法規與消費者需求與其他市場截然不同，如何為美國開發車款成為核心難題。因此，Stellantis在美國完全依賴本土工程與研發力量，但在歐洲等其他市場，則選擇與零跑、東風等中國車廠合作。
值得注意的是，這些合作明確表示不涉及面向美國市場的車型規劃。此前，採取類似模式的福特已遭到白宮抨擊。
美國政府官員批評福特與吉利在歐洲成立合資企業，認為此舉是在幫助中國車場擴大全球業務。福特則回應指合作是為了適應新的全球現實，旨在讓業務更精幹、更有效率。
隨著全球汽車產業格局加速重構，個各車廠如何在分化市場中平衡區域策略，將成為產業共同面臨的考驗。
paras_en: Stellantis Group CEO Antonio Filosa said last Thursday (the 10th) at an analyst meeting that the current global automotive market has clearly divided into two parts: the United States and the rest of the world.
Stellantis is facing increasingly divergent trade and policy environments in places like the US and Europe, especially as its cooperation models with Chinese companies differ markedly.

Filosa emphasized that the United States is Stellantis’s biggest profit source, but local regulations and consumer demand are completely different from other markets, making the development of US‑specific models a core challenge. Consequently, Stellantis relies entirely on domestic engineering and R&D in the US, while in Europe and other regions it chooses to partner with Chinese automakers such as Leapmotor and Dongfeng.
It is noteworthy that these partnerships explicitly state they do not involve vehicle planning for the US market. Previously, Ford, which used a similar model, was criticized by the White House.

US officials criticized Ford and Geely for setting up a joint venture in Europe, saying the move helps Chinese automakers expand globally. Ford responded that the cooperation is meant to adapt to a new global reality, aiming to make its business leaner and more efficient.
As the global automotive industry’s structure rapidly reshapes, how each automaker balances regional strategies in a divided market will become a common challenge for the sector.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 Fed下周升息可能性提高
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises as Fed Rate‑Hike Likelihood Increases Next Week
paras: 美元周五(11日)小幅走高，受到消費者通膨報告推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期的提振。但就本周而言，美元變化不大，交易員反而將注意力集中在美國公債殖利率及日元的大幅反彈上。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)0.1%，報99.13。
匯市參與者周五將焦點集中在最新公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月整體CPI與核心CPI月增率分別為0.4%和0.3%，市場原先預期分別為0.4%和0.2%，且兩者均較7月的0.1%和0.2%加快。
以年增率來看，8月整體CPI上升3.4%，與7月持平。核心CPI則從2.5%降至2.4%，兩項數據均符合市場預期。
CPI數據進一步推升聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)下周升息25個基點的可能性。根據CME FedWatch工具，通膨數據公布後，市場預期升息25個基點的機率從數據公布前約69%，大幅升至接近87%。
儘管PPI和CPI都是市場密切關注的通膨指標，但FOMC更重視個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，將其視為主要通膨衡量指標。PPI和CPI中的部分項目會納入PCE計算，而PCE通膨率已連續65個月高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
在8月CPI公布前，市場對升息的預期已逐步升溫。7月時，3位地區聯準會主席對FOMC維持利率不變的決定提出異議，到了8月底，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度央行年會上發表明顯偏鷹的演說，指出潛在通膨趨勢並未改善。
同時，其他經濟指標也進一步提高貨幣政策收緊的可能性，包括上周大幅優於預期的非農就業報告，以及周四公布、顯示整體通膨加速的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
此外，美國與伊朗局勢升溫導致近期油價大幅上漲，進一步加劇市場對通膨的擔憂，也增加美國民眾加油的負擔。美國柴油價格周四更首次突破每加侖6美元。
美國債券市場尤其反映出市場對升息預期持續升溫的情況。自聯準會7月利率決策前後，美債市場便陷入拋售，尤其是長天期債券跌勢更加明顯。殖利率隨後大幅攀升，推動美國30年期公債殖利率升至近20年高點，也促使美國財政部提高長天期公債的回購規模。
然而，美國財政部出乎市場預期的干預並未達到預期效果。CPI公布後，美債周五大致持續走弱，10年期美債殖利率最新上升3.2個基點至4.976%，對利率更敏感的2年期殖利率則上升8.8個基點至4.638%。
市場普遍認為，CPI數據成為最後一根稻草，使升息預期明確轉向升息。
Macquarie經濟學主管David Doyle表示，「我們的基本預期仍是聯準會下周升息，而CPI數據公布後，我們對這項判斷的信心進一步提高。在我們看來，在8月強勁的就業報告公布後，除非通膨數據出現偏鴿派的意外，否則維持利率不變的可能性就會降低。儘管數據內部細項顯示，月增核心PCE可能沒有那麼強勁，但整體而言仍足以支持升息25個基點。」
日元創5月初來首度連兩周上漲
日元自上周以來一直是外匯市場焦點。日元周五進一步升值，創下5月初以來首次連續兩周上漲。美元兌日元下跌0.5%至153.72，本周累計下跌1.6%。
日元近期大幅反彈，反映市場愈來愈相信日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將於9月18日升息。
東京周五公布，8月企業物價指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於市場預期的7.4%，顯示進口成本飆升正直接傳導至日本國內的生產端通膨壓力。
DBS分析師指出，儘管市場普遍預期日本銀行將升息25個基點，但市場真正關注的將是政策制定者是否釋放出「彈性、取決於經濟數據」的政策路徑訊號，而非承諾快速連續升息。
歐元在ECB升息後周線下跌
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%至1.1597美元，本周累計下跌0.2%。
歐元走弱之際，歐洲央行(ECB)周四將主要政策利率上調25個基點。ECB表示，中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來價格壓力。
ECB在聲明中警告，衝突仍在「產生通膨壓力」，通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的目標。
此外，《彭博社》周四報導，知情人士透露，ECB官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 11th), buoyed by a consumer‑inflation report that lifted expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Over the week, however, the dollar showed little movement, and traders focused instead on U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp rebound in the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.1% at 99.13.

FX market participants on Friday centered on the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) release. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, August’s overall CPI and core CPI rose 0.4% and 0.3% month‑over‑month, respectively, versus market expectations of 0.4% and 0.2%, and both accelerated from July’s 0.1% and 0.2% gains.
On an annual basis, August’s overall CPI increased 3.4%, unchanged from July. Core CPI slipped from 2.5% to 2.4%, with both figures matching market forecasts.

The CPI data further boosted the probability that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will raise rates by 25 basis points next week. The CME FedWatch tool shows the odds of a 25‑bp hike jumping from roughly 69% before the data to nearly 87% after the release.

Although both the PPI and CPI are closely watched inflation gauges, the FOMC places greater emphasis on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index as its primary inflation measure. Some items from the PPI and CPI feed into the PCE calculation, and the PCE inflation rate has now been above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target for 65 consecutive months.

Even before the August CPI was released, market expectations for a rate hike were warming. In July, three regional Fed presidents voiced dissent against keeping rates unchanged, and by the end of August, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a decidedly hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole annual central‑bank meeting, noting that underlying inflation trends had not improved.

At the same time, other economic indicators further raised the likelihood of tighter monetary policy, including last week’s non‑farm payrolls that far exceeded expectations and Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) report, which showed an acceleration in overall inflation.

In addition, heightened tensions between the United States and Iran have pushed oil prices sharply higher, intensifying inflation concerns and increasing the cost of fueling for Americans. U.S. diesel prices broke the $6‑per‑gallon mark for the first time on Thursday.

The U.S. bond market especially reflected the growing rate‑hike expectations. Since the Fed’s July rate decision, Treasury markets entered a sell‑off, with long‑dated bonds falling the most. Yields then surged, lifting the 30‑year Treasury yield to near a 20‑year high and prompting the Treasury to expand its long‑term bond buy‑back program.

However, the Treasury’s unexpected intervention did not achieve the desired effect. After the CPI release, Treasuries continued to weaken on Friday, with the 10‑year yield rising 3.2 basis points to 4.976% and the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbing 8.8 basis points to 4.638%.
The market broadly views the CPI data as the final straw that turned rate‑hike expectations decisively upward.

Macquarie chief economist David Doyle said, “Our baseline view remains that the Fed will raise rates next week, and the CPI release has increased our confidence in that judgment. In our view, after the strong August jobs report, unless inflation data surprise on the dovish side, the odds of a hold diminish. While some components of the data suggest core PCE may not be as strong, overall it still supports a 25‑bp hike.”
The yen posted its first consecutive two‑week rise since early May.

The yen has been a focal point in the FX market since last week. On Friday it appreciated further, marking the first back‑to‑back weekly gains since early May. The dollar fell 0.5% against the yen to 153.72, down 1.6% for the week.
The yen’s recent sharp rebound reflects growing market belief that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates on September 18.

Tokyo reported on Friday that August’s Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑over‑year, above the 7.4% consensus, indicating that soaring import costs are directly feeding domestic production‑side inflation pressure.

DBS analysts noted that although the market broadly expects a 25‑bp rate hike from the BOJ, the real focus will be on whether policymakers signal a “flexible, data‑dependent” policy path rather than committing to rapid, consecutive hikes.
The euro fell on the weekly chart after the ECB’s rate hike.
The euro slipped 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1597, down 0.2% for the week.

As the euro weakened, the European Central Bank raised its main policy rate by 25 basis points on Thursday. The ECB said Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price increases continue to exert price pressure.
In its statement, the ECB warned that the conflict is still “creating inflationary pressure,” and that inflation is expected to remain “significantly above the 2% target for a prolonged period.”
Additionally, Bloomberg reported on Thursday that sources said ECB officials anticipate further rate hikes, possibly as early as next month.
